_comment: Types round 5 (docs/notes/types_5.md): iMUSE's music tables. The state table (181 records, ids 1000..1500) and the sequence table (41 records, ids 2000..2399) share one record layout; Script_Trans plays the record's sound file, ImSetState / ImSetSequence find a record by id. The name alias table maps a sound name to its file name (170 entries and an empty one that ends it). The code addresses the columns by number (id at +0x24, name at +0x28, hook slot at +0x40, transition type at +0x20), so Ghidra had labels in the middle of the records.

structs.name: ImMusicEntry
structs.comment: One record of iMUSE's state table g_aImStateTable or sequence table g_aImSeqTable (Script_Trans).
fields: the sound file, renamed through g_aImNameAlias; empty: no music
transition type, Script_Trans's jump table (0..12): 0 none, 2, 3 used by the game
hook counter slot (0: the state's index)
the hook counter cycles up to this
fade time; the volume / pan step is nFade * 3 / 50

structs.name: ImNameAlias
structs.comment: One entry of g_aImNameAlias: a sound name and the file it is played from (Script_Trans); an empty aFrom ends the table.
